Grokmark setup

Only your best bookmarks get seen.

1. Cloudflare

Create a Workers AI API token scoped to Workers AI only. Grokmark sends it only to api.cloudflare.com.

2. About you

The bouncer reads this before judging every bookmark.

Products, tools, companies or people, separated by commas. Add a few words in brackets for anything obscure.

3. Grok Bot webhook

Copy the URL and key from the routine's Webhook section in the Grok Bot desktop app. Every VIP goes here.

Posts one sample item to this webhook right now, so you can see the routine fire.

Try it

Needs an x.com tab open. Nothing is sent. Mark any verdict you disagree with.
